AST_PARSING_FAILED.label: Code map unavailable
AST_PARSING_FAILED.help: The repository's syntax tree could not be built. The run continues without the code map, so the agents see less of the codebase.

COMMENT_ISSUE_FAILED.label: Issue comment failed
COMMENT_ISSUE_FAILED.help: The decision could not be posted as a comment on the GitHub issue. The run continues; check the GitHub App's issue permissions.

CREATE_ISSUE_FAILED.label: Issue creation failed
CREATE_ISSUE_FAILED.help: The proposed task could not be opened as a GitHub issue. The run continues; check the GitHub App's issue permissions.

DECISION_PARSE_FAILED.label: Agent decision rejected
DECISION_PARSE_FAILED.help: An agent's decision was not in the expected format and was treated as a rejection.

FETCH_ISSUE_FAILED.label: Could not fetch issue
FETCH_ISSUE_FAILED.help: GitHub did not return the target issue (an outage, a rate limit or a credentials problem). Starting the run again later may succeed.

GITHUB_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.label: GitHub access unavailable
GITHUB_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.help: The run could not get GitHub credentials for this repository. Check that the GitHub App is installed on it and linked to your organization.

GITNEXUS_INDEXING_FAILED.label: Code index unavailable
GITNEXUS_INDEXING_FAILED.help: Indexing the repository failed. The run continues without the index, so the agents see less of the codebase.

INVALID_GENERATED_CODE.label: Generated code rejected
INVALID_GENERATED_CODE.help: The implementer's output failed validation (for example it did not parse or dropped most of the file), so nothing was committed.

INVALID_REPOSITORY.label: Invalid repository
INVALID_REPOSITORY.help: The run has no valid owner/repo target. Set the target repository and start again.

INVALID_TARGET_ISSUE.label: Target issue not found
INVALID_TARGET_ISSUE.help: The issue does not exist in this repository or is not visible to the run's credentials. Correct the issue number; running again unchanged fails the same way.

LLM_EXECUTION_FAILED.label: Language model unavailable
LLM_EXECUTION_FAILED.help: The language model did not return a response (an outage or a rate limit). Try again in a few minutes.

MERGE_FAILED.label: Merge failed
MERGE_FAILED.help: GitHub did not merge the pull request, for example because its head changed or a branch protection rule blocked it. The pull request stays open.

NO_TARGET_FILE.label: No target file
NO_TARGET_FILE.help: The task does not reference a repository file (such as path/to/file.py:10-25), so there is nothing to change. Add a file reference to the issue.

PROTECTED_PATH.label: Protected path
PROTECTED_PATH.help: The change touches a path the change limits deny (workflows, lockfiles, secrets, test configuration, .automaintainer.yml), so nothing was committed. A person has to make this change.

PR_COMMENT_FAILED.label: Pull request comment failed
PR_COMMENT_FAILED.help: The review could not be posted on the pull request. The run continues; check the GitHub App's pull request permissions.

PR_DIFF_UNAVAILABLE.label: Pull request diff unavailable
PR_DIFF_UNAVAILABLE.help: The pull request's diff could not be loaded, so it was not reviewed or merged. Starting the run again later may succeed.

RATE_LIMIT_REACHED.label: Rate limit reached
RATE_LIMIT_REACHED.help: The language model's rate limit was reached. Wait a minute before starting another run.

REPO_CLONE_FAILED.label: Repository clone failed
REPO_CLONE_FAILED.help: The worker could not clone the repository, so the run had no working copy. Check that the GitHub App can read the repository and the worker can reach GitHub, then start the run again.

REPO_SYNC_FAILED.label: Repository update failed
REPO_SYNC_FAILED.help: Not a run failure: updating the existing local clone failed, so the run continued on the cached copy, which may be behind the latest commits.

RUN_CANCELLED.label: Run cancelled
RUN_CANCELLED.help: The run was stopped before it finished.

RUN_FAILED.label: Run failed
RUN_FAILED.help: The run stopped on an unexpected error. The message has the details; the worker log has the full trace.

TARGET_FILE_TOO_LARGE.label: Target file too large
TARGET_FILE_TOO_LARGE.help: The file is above the size the implementer can rewrite in full, so the run stopped rather than commit a truncated file.

TARGET_IS_PULL_REQUEST.label: Target is a pull request
TARGET_IS_PULL_REQUEST.help: The number given is a pull request, not an issue. Target an issue instead.

VERIFICATION_STATUS_FAILED.label: Verification status not recorded
VERIFICATION_STATUS_FAILED.help: The verification result could not be posted on the pull request, so under the ci merge policy it was not merged. Starting the run again later may succeed.
